quests.title: The Warrawee Order
quests.blurb: I have made the same order for the same person every morning since I opened at Warrawee. Since school holidays they have not turned up, and nobody upstairs wants to hear it. Go and knock.

steps.label: order one at the Warrawee kiosk
the office they walk to, or used to
come back with $66 — I am not running a charity

quests.title: Four Minutes at Kogarah
quests.blurb: Nobody upstairs believes me about Kogarah because I have 31 years and no data. Go and stand on that platform on Thursdays and get me the data, and nobody will put it in writing.

steps.label: stand under the board and wait like everyone else
photograph the board saying four minutes
ride the one that finally comes
give me the number

quests.title: Unclaimed at Denistone
quests.blurb: Everything anyone leaves on the Denistone line ends up in a room and the room is full. Nine hundred umbrellas and one a milk crate with a name on it and a number that rings out. Go to the address on the tag.

steps.label: the address on the tag
the two who got there before you
$77 — whatever it is, it is worth that to somebody

quests.title: The Quiet Carriage, Benaud Oval
quests.blurb: The quiet carriage runs on shame and somebody on the just gone midnight out of Benaud Oval has stopped feeling it. Ride it, see the crime, and apply the shame manually.

steps.label: ride the quiet carriage and observe the crime
apply the shame manually
photograph the sign, for the record

quests.title: The Croydon Shortcut
quests.blurb: Every courier has a route that is not on a map and mine goes through Croydon. They have started locking one end. Go and find out whether it is locked forever or just locked today.

steps.label: the end they lock
the long way round, so you understand what it costs
$69, which is what the long way costs me a week

quests.title: Possession at Turrella
quests.blurb: We own the track between midnight and four and in that window we are the only people in this city doing anything real. Somebody keeps walking through my possession at Turrella. Find them before a grinder does.

steps.label: where they come through the fence
the ones who think a hard hat is a costume
photograph the gap so I can put a number on the form

quests.title: The Hills Showground Regular
quests.blurb: Same stool since before I bought the place off Hills Showground road. Gone since every second Friday, and they keep sending a different bloke. I would like to know whether to keep the stool.

steps.label: the house they say he moved to
you cannot ask a favour empty-handed
come back and tell me straight

quests.title: Bay 14, Regents Park
quests.blurb: People have started parking on the grass at Regents Park because of one abandoned car, and nobody upstairs wants to hear it. Photograph it, and the date on the ticket, so somebody can be embarrassed by it.

steps.label: the car, and the ticket, and the date on it
the two arguing over the grass
$58 in fines nobody is going to collect

quests.title: Whatever Is Under the Grey at Dundas
quests.blurb: Council pays me to paint over things and last week I painted over something good. There is another one near Dundas that I am scheduled to kill on every second Friday. Photograph it first.

steps.label: the wall, before they get to it
photograph it properly, not a phone-in-a-hurry job
show me

quests.title: The Hill Above Woy Woy
quests.blurb: There is a bench on the hill above Woy Woy I have watched from a moving bus about fourteen thousand times. I am not going to stop — that is not the kind of person I turned out to be. So you go, at just gone midnight, when the light is worth it.

steps.label: up the hill, the way the road does not go
the view I have never stopped for
$53, because I am paying you for it

quests.title: Contesting It at Austinmer
quests.blurb: Two hundred and eighty-five dollars at Austinmer for a thing the sign did not say, because the sign is not there. The form wants evidence. Go and photograph the absence.

steps.label: where the sign is supposed to be
photograph the absence, which is harder than it sounds
the one who tells you photography is not allowed here

quests.title: The Strip Outside Vineyard
quests.blurb: Nobody planted the strip at Vineyard. I did, on Thursdays, at the second express, so nobody would ask. I would like the fifteenth to go badly for council.

steps.label: the strip, which is a garden now
the man with the whipper snipper
photograph it while it still exists

quests.title: Night Fill, Dulwich Hill
quests.blurb: Started on every second Friday. In off the Dulwich Hill late train, gone before the first delivery, every time, and nobody upstairs wants to hear it. Come in on the late one and watch the loading door.

steps.label: come in on the late one like they do
the loading door nobody watches
whoever is standing in it at two in the morning
$74 of what they took, back

quests.title: The Window Above Merrylands
quests.blurb: I live above the platform at Merrylands and I know this line by sound. Something in the rhythm changed about a month ago and everyone I tell thinks I am mad. Ride it and tell me whether I am mad.

steps.label: ride it and listen to the joins
photograph the stretch that sounds wrong
tell me I am not mad

quests.title: Setting Up at Parramatta
quests.blurb: 8 years in the Parramatta market. The bays are not allocated, they are *known*, and since a Tuesday somebody has decided that knowing does not count, and I have run out of ways to say it politely.

steps.label: the bays, at the hour it happens
the bloke with the extra trestle
you will want one at that hour
$51 of frontage, recovered

quests.title: The Clock at Eastwood
quests.blurb: The clock on the Eastwood platform has been four minutes fast since I got here and every relief who comes through wants to fix it. Do not fix it. Find out who set it that way, before they retire.

steps.label: the clock, four minutes fast, for the file
to Denistone, where the old crew drink
bring the name back

quests.title: The Dog at Sutherland
quests.blurb: Sits at the yellow line at Sutherland at just gone midnight, waits, then walks off on its own. Half the platform knows and nobody has done anything, including me, and I am past being reasonable about it.

steps.label: the end of the platform, at twenty to six
the street it walks home to
tell me it is not a sad story

quests.title: The Book at Stanwell Park
quests.blurb: Up four hundred over eleven weeks on the Stanwell Park delay market. You cannot beat a delay book unless you can see the roster, and I am the only one who seems to have noticed. Think about who can see the roster.

steps.label: ride the run they ride
the two who follow you off it
$83 back off the book

quests.title: Last Service out of Lidcombe
quests.blurb: Nothing runs out of Lidcombe after knock-off. I lock this end and a fella with a rescue greyhound locks the other and in between there is a kilometre of lit platform for nobody. Ride the last one to Berala and bring me a photograph of that.

steps.label: ride the late one to Berala
the empty platform, lit and pointless
tell them what you saw
